items.title: 4 miners die in coal mine gas explosion in Balochistan's Harnai
items.description:
Four miners died while another four were injured after a gas explosion at a coal mine in the Shahrag area of Balochistan’s Harnai district, officials said.
According to rescue sources, the incident occurred at PMDC Coal Mine 151 in Shahrag, where a powerful explosion took place following the accumulation of methane gas.
“Eight miners were trapped deep inside the mine as fire broke out after the blast,”  Muhammad Atif Khan, the Balochistan chief inspector of mines, told Dawn.

items.title: Justice Ayesha Malik honoured with 'international leader' award in Vienna
items.description:
ISLAMABAD: Supreme Court’s Justice Ayesha Malik has been conferred the International Leader/Lifetime Award at the Justitia Awards 2026 held in Vienna, Austria.
The prestigious award recognised her distinguished contribution to the development of law and justice, as well as her sustained efforts to advance equality, human rights and the meaningful participation of women in the legal profession and institutions of justice.

items.title: PM Shehbaz announces 'relief scheme' for bikes, autos, 800cc vehicles amid rising fuel prices
items.description:
Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif on Sunday announced a “relief scheme” for users of motorcycles, autos and vehicles of up to 800cc to “alleviate the burden” of rising global oil prices.
Renewed hostilities in the Middle East, which have resulted in disruption of major oil supply routes, have caused fuel prices to rise in the past two months. In addition to the crisis in the Strait of Hormuz due to the US-Iran war, trade via Bab al-Mandab — which has become a vital route for Saudi oil exports in recent months — is also facing a rising threat from Houthi rebels.

items.description:
PESHAWAR: A policeman was injured on Sunday after a wall, built recently for an inaugural plaque for an upgradation project of Peshawar’s major routes, collapsed, with Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Chief Minister Sohail Afridi also present at the ceremony.
Officials said that the police official had been deployed as part of security at the inaugural ceremony, where the KP CM was invited as well.

items.description:
The brother of Hina Javed, who was found dead last month, has written to the National Commission on Human Rights (NCHR), requesting intervention in the investigation of her sister’s murder case, as the family alleges that the probe was compromised.

items.description:
Donald Trump turned his focus Sunday to golf and promoting his business interests, as he wraps up a two-day visit to Ireland during which his off-the-cuff diplomacy has caused another stir.
The US president caught his Irish hosts and the neighbouring UK off-guard Saturday when he waded into highly sensitive political territory by announcing he would “love to see” a united Ireland.

items.title: Pakistan to continue efforts for 'defusing' regional tensions, PM tells Saudi crown prince
items.description:
Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif on Sunday told Saudi Arabia’s Crown Prince Mohammed Bin Salman that Pakistan would continue its efforts for “defusing” regional tensions and expressed solidarity with the Gulf state in light of recent Houthi attacks.
The development comes amid renewed tensions in the region, with Yemen’s Houthi rebels launching attacks on oil installations in Saudi Arabia earlier this week, injuring 73 people. A day earlier, a crucial Saudi oil pipeline also came under attack by drones launched from Iraq.
